package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/myapp/handler"
	"example.com/myapp/transport"
)

// scenario for cross_layer_import_violation_by_package_name: Imports where package names clearly violate a layered direction such as `repository -> handler` or `model -> gin`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

type UserRepository struct{}

func (r *UserRepository) FindByID(id string) error {
	h := handler.UserHandler{}
	h.LogAccess(id)

	t := transport.NewHTTPClient()
	fmt.Println(t)

	return fmt.Errorf("cross_layer_import_violation_by_package_name: repository importing handler and transport")
}
